title: Rare Vintage Mini Cousances Cocotte – Le Creuset Group – Orange Enameled Cast Iron Collectible
description:
Very rare vintage mini Cousances cocotte, part of the Le Creuset group, made in iconic orange enameled cast iron. A beautiful and highly collectible piece, perfect for vintage cookware enthusiasts, Le Creuset collectors, or retro kitchen décor lovers.
This miniature cocotte features the classic vibrant orange color typical of vintage French cookware and charming authentic details throughout. The “Sou-Vide” markings visible under both the cocotte and lid add even more character and rarity to this unique item.
Good vintage condition with signs of age and a few enamel chips visible in the photos, consistent with its age and authentic vintage character.
Approximate dimensions:
Diameter: approx. 8 cm
Height: approx. 5 cm
A rare and hard-to-find collector’s piece, ideal for display, collection, or vintage culinary styling.
